result.summary: Mehtab Agro Foods has two open overdue notifications totaling INR 6.0M across both its policies (TCI-SCF-2026-0001 and TCI-WT-2026-0002), with the oldest now 64 days past due (original due date 2026-09-20) vs. a single prior overdue that resolved in 18 days. Notification volume rose from 1 to 2 in the last six months, now spread across both policies, signaling accumulating payment stress well above the single prior incident. Combined exposure (6.0M overdue, plus 4.7M not-yet-due) remains within the combined 23M credit limits, but the aging and multi-policy spread warrant closer monitoring.
concerns: Oldest overdue has reached 64 days past due, materially worse than the 18-day resolution seen historically
Overdue notifications now arriving from both policies simultaneously (2 of 2) rather than a single policy
Accumulation trend rising: 2 notifications in the last 6-month window vs 1 in the prior window
Limited history (only one prior resolved case) constrains confidence but the direction is clearly worsening
